f.title: Comply with the GCP, evaluation and oversight rules for registration clinical pharmacology studies (Annexes I-V)
f.statement: The rules on Good Clinical Practice, evaluation and oversight of clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes, set out in Annexes I to V, are approved and form an integral part of the disposition.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes in Argentina (Phase I, II, III and phase variations); in force from 1 Dec 2025. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 1°.- Apruébanse las normas sobre BUENAS PRÁCTICAS CLÍNICAS, DE EVALUACIÓN Y FISCALIZACIÓN DE ESTUDIOS DE FARMACOLOGÍA CLÍNICA CON FINES REGISTRALES que obran como Anexo I (IF-2025-111781941-APN-INAME#ANMAT), Anexo II (IF-2025-111782235-APN-INAME#ANMAT), Anexo III (IF-2025-111782318-APN-INAME#ANMAT), Anexo IV (IF-2025-111782633-APN-INAME#ANMAT) y Anexo V (IF-2025-111782721-APN-INAME#ANMAT) y forman parte integrante de la presente disposición.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; operative approval of Annexes I-V (the specific duties are curated from the annexes). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful). Below 90: "Apruébanse" is an approving provision with no modal verb, and the sponsor actor is inferred; framing row whose duties sit in the annexes.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 1.- The rules on GOOD CLINICAL PRACTICE, EVALUATION AND OVERSIGHT OF CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY STUDIES FOR REGISTRATION PURPOSES, set out as Annex I (IF-2025-111781941-APN-INAME#ANMAT), Annex II (IF-2025-111782235-APN-INAME#ANMAT), Annex III (IF-2025-111782318-APN-INAME#ANMAT), Annex IV (IF-2025-111782633-APN-INAME#ANMAT) and Annex V (IF-2025-111782721-APN-INAME#ANMAT), are approved and form an integral part of this disposition.

f.title: Apply ICH E6(R3) GCP to registration clinical trials, complemented by the local requirements of Annex II
f.statement: The ICH E6(R3) Good Clinical Practice guideline (Annex I) is adopted for pharmacological clinical trials for registration purposes and must be complemented by the local regulatory requirements described in Annex II.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes in Argentina (Phase I, II, III and phase variations); in force from 1 Dec 2025. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 3°.- Adóptase la GUÍA DE BUENAS PRÁCTICAS CLÍNICAS DEL CONSEJO INTERNACIONAL DE ARMONIZACIÓN ICH E6 VERSIÓN R3 para los ensayos clínicos farmacológicos con fines registrales que consta en el Anexo I mencionado en el artículo 1° de la presente, la que deberá complementarse con los requisitos regulatorios locales descriptos en el Anexo II del mencionado artículo.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberá complementarse' = shall be complemented, Mandatory confirmed. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberá complementarse" = Mandatory. Below 90: passive, the sponsor actor is inferred rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 3.- The GOOD CLINICAL PRACTICE GUIDELINE OF THE INTERNATIONAL COUNCIL FOR HARMONISATION ICH E6 VERSION R3 is adopted for pharmacological clinical trials for registration purposes, as set out in Annex I referred to in Article 1 hereof, and it shall be complemented by the local regulatory requirements described in Annex II of the said article.

f.title: Scope: registration Phase I-III studies and post-registration changes needing trial data; BE/BA, non-interventional and non-registration studies excluded
f.statement: The rules apply to clinical pharmacology studies for registration, or studies with already registered medicines that evaluate, for registration purposes, a new indication, a higher new strength, a new posology, a new pharmaceutical form or any other post-registration change requiring clinical trial data. Phase I, II and III studies and protocol phase variations for registration purposes are covered. Bioequivalence and bioavailability studies (governed by specific ANMAT rules), non-interventional studies and studies without registration purposes are excluded.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes in Argentina (Phase I, II, III and phase variations); in force from 1 Dec 2025. Original language Spanish.
f.exceptions: Bioequivalence and bioavailability studies, non-interventional studies and studies without registration purposes are excluded.

rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 4°.- El ámbito de aplicación de la presente norma son los estudios de farmacología clínica con fines de registro o estudios con medicamentos ya registrados que evalúen con fines registrales, una nueva indicación, nueva concentración si es mayor a la ya registrada, nueva posología, nueva forma farmacéutica o cualquier otra modificación post registro que requiera de datos de ensayos clínicos. Se encuentran alcanzados por la presente normativa los estudios de Fase I, II y III y las variaciones de fases de protocolo con fines registrales. Quedan excluidos los estudios de bioequivalencia y biodisponibilidad para los que aplican normativas específicas de esta Administración, así como también los estudios no intervencionales y los estudios sin fines registrales.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; scope provision kept as it defines which studies the duties apply to. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Below 90: scope provision with no modal verb (Mandatory as a binding scope definition is a judgement call); actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 4.- The scope of application of this rule is clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes, or studies with already registered medicinal products that evaluate, for registration purposes, a new indication, a new strength if higher than the one already registered, a new posology, a new pharmaceutical form or any other post-registration modification that requires clinical trial data. Phase I, II and III studies and protocol phase variations for registration purposes are covered by these rules. Bioequivalence and bioavailability studies, for which specific rules of this Administration apply, are excluded, as are non-interventional studies and studies without registration purposes.

f.title: Obtain ANMAT authorisation before conducting an in-scope clinical pharmacology study
f.statement: Sponsors must request authorisation from ANMAT before conducting studies within the scope of the disposition, complying with the requirements it establishes.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes in Argentina (Phase I, II, III and phase variations); in force from 1 Dec 2025. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Los patrocinadores deberán solicitar autorización a la Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica (ANMAT) antes de realizar estudios alcanzados por la presente normativa, dando cumplimiento a los requisitos aquí establecidos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberán solicitar' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "Los patrocinadores deberán solicitar" gives the Mandatory level and the explicit actor; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Sponsors shall request authorisation from the National Administration of Medicines, Food and Medical Technology (ANMAT) before conducting studies covered by these rules, complying with the requirements set out herein.

f.title: Apply the new GCP regime from 1 Dec 2025; 6677/10 and related rules repealed; pending procedures decided under the old rules
f.statement: Dispositions ANMAT 6677/10, 4008/17, 9929/19 and 2172/25, Circulars 0001/11 and 004/18 and the Circular of 10 June 2024 are repealed. The disposition enters into force on 1 December 2025. Procedures pending resolution on that date will be evaluated and resolved under the repealed rules.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes in Argentina (Phase I, II, III and phase variations); in force from 1 Dec 2025. Original language Spanish.
f.exceptions: Procedures pending resolution on 1 Dec 2025 are evaluated and resolved under the repealed rules.

rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 7°.- Deróganse las Disposiciones ANMAT Nros. 6677/10, 4008/17, 9929/19 y 2172/25 y las Circulares Nros. 0001/11 y 004/18 y la Circular del 10 de junio de 2024. ARTÍCULO 8°.- La presente disposición entrará en vigencia el 1° de diciembre de 2025. Los trámites pendientes de resolución a la entrada en vigencia de la presente disposición serán evaluados y resueltos en los términos de las normas mencionadas en el artículo 7°.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; transitional rule (repeal, entry into force 1 Dec 2025, pending procedures under old rules). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; dates 1 Dec 2025 checked. Below 90: repeal/entry-into-force provision with no duty-bearing modal verb ("Deróganse", "entrará en vigencia"); actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 7.- ANMAT Dispositions Nos. 6677/10, 4008/17, 9929/19 and 2172/25, Circulars Nos. 0001/11 and 004/18 and the Circular of 10 June 2024 are repealed. ARTICLE 8.- This disposition shall enter into force on 1 December 2025. Procedures pending resolution when this disposition enters into force shall be evaluated and resolved under the terms of the rules mentioned in Article 7.
